definitions: The final result or outcome of a series of actions, influences, or calculations, especially after all additions and subtractions have been made.
The overall impact or consequence when all contributing factors are considered.
examples: The net effect of the policy changes was a slight increase in revenue.
Despite several setbacks, the net effect on the project timeline was minimal.
What is the net effect of these economic reforms?
The net effect of the new regulations is still being evaluated.
